parameter.name: refresh
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Poll interval in seconds. Use zero to disable automatic polling.

parameter.name: maxTries
parameter.label: Maximum Tries When Reading
parameter.description: Number of tries when reading data, if some of the reading fail. For single try, enter 1.

parameter.name: stateBlockLength
parameter.label: State block length
parameter.description: Length of the state block in registers to read from bus

parameter.name: nrOfHps
parameter.label: Number of heat pumps
parameter.description: Number of heat pumps in a WPMsystem or WPM3 based environment.

parameter.name: pollSgReady
parameter.label: Poll SG Ready Registers
parameter.description: Flag to enable polling of the SG Ready registers.
